# Nell Harcourt

## Overview

- **Age:** 16 or 17 years old  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v2 c8 P61](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0061)</sub>

## Appearance

Nell is a tall, slender girl with a pale, freckled face, a sharp chin, a wide mouth, and large, expressive gray eyes that shift hue in different lights. She possesses intense, thick hair that is initially bright red before darkening into an attractive auburn as she matures, which she briefly crops short after a hair-dyeing mishap. Over time, her posture becomes graceful and regal, and her style shifts from plain, modest handmade dresses to stylish, tailored clothing.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c9 P13](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0013), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c11 P2](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0002), [v1 c27 P33](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0033), [v1 c27 P39](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0039), [v1 c28 P4](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0004), [v1 c28 P6](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0006), [v1 c29 P15](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0015), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v1 c33 P10](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0010)_

## Personality

Nell possesses a vivid, wild imagination and an intense love for beauty and nature, frequently bestowing poetic names upon local landmarks, plants, and trees. She is deeply dramatic, highly loquacious, and prone to romanticizing both joy and suffering, often slipping into daydreams and lost thoughts mid-task. Though she harbors a fiery, explosive temper when teased about her red hair or plain appearance, she is fundamentally kind, loyal, and eager to please those she cares for. She holds strong moral ambitions and constantly strives for personal and spiritual self-improvement.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P24](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0024), [v1 c2 P53](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0053), [v1 c2 P56](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0056), [v1 c4 P14](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0014), [v1 c4 P35](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0035), [v1 c7 P12](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0012), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c9 P41](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0041), [v1 c10 P43](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0043), [v1 c26 P6](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0006), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006)_

## History

Mistakenly brought to Brierley by Obed Abernethy in place of an expected orphan boy, Nell arrives at Grey Shutters and initially despairs upon learning she is unwanted. However, Obed and Thirza Abernethy decide to keep her, and she quickly forms a deep bond with Obed while adjusting to Thirza's strict discipline. Nell forms a passionate friendship with Isolde Pembroke, naming local landmarks such as Linger Lane, the Lake of Glassy Waters, and the Nymph's Well. After a series of dramatic mishaps—including a furious outburst at Mrs. Agatha Sowerby, an accidental hat decoration at church, and an unintentional poisoning of Isolde with homemade currant wine—she overcomes local prejudice and becomes well-loved in Brierley. Nell enters Brierley School, where she engages in an intense academic rivalry with Hugh Carrow, which culminates in her temporarily quitting school after breaking a slate over his head and being forced to sit beside him. Later, she saves Posy Fay Pembroke from croup using her past experience with infants, restoring her severed friendship with Isolde. She subsequently wins the Avery Scholarship at Regent's Academy, but chooses to forfeit her college plans to remain at Grey Shutters and work as Brierley's schoolteacher to support Thirza after Obed's sudden death. Over her two years of teaching, Nell inspires her students, forms a local Improvement Society, helps raise the orphaned Farrow twins, and reconciles with Hugh Carrow, ultimately deciding to pursue her college degree locally at Grey Shutters.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c3 P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c12 P1](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0001), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c15 P4](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0004), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P81](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0081), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c18 P30](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0030), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007), [v1 c38 P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055), [v2 c4 P1](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0001), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031)_

## Background by volume

- Born in Harborough, Nova Scotia to high school teachers Edmund and Bertha Harcourt, both of whom died of fever when she was an infant  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised by hand by Mrs. Thomas in Harborough and Marysville until age eight  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived up-river with Mrs. Rudge for over two years, helping care for eight children including three sets of twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Spent four months at the Marden orphan asylum before being brought to St. Brendan's Island by Mrs. Alexander Tranter  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
